selected_evidence.requirement: New passwords must be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the installed settings and direct pre- and post-restart behavioral tests for both thresholds.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 9bdcc129-3d25-48ff-ad64-56be332fb91e, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 4a81e8f9-24aa-4a14-97c8-4edb510dc9c9, recovered system state, persistent PAM configuration, and successful post-restart policy enforcement.

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d
tmp=/etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/.99-password-policy.conf.tmp
umask 022
printf '%s\n' '# Managed password complexity policy' 'minlen = 12' 'minclass = 3' > "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
restorecon /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- installed policy ---'
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
commands.stdout:
--- installed policy ---
root:root 644 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
# Managed password complexity policy
minlen = 12
minclass = 3

commands.command:
set -u
randchars() { tr -dc "$1" </dev/urandom | head -c "$2"; }
short_pass="$(randchars 'a-z' 3)$(randchars 'A-Z' 3)$(randchars '0-9' 3)$(randchars '!@#%^+=' 2)"
two_class_pass="$(randchars 'a-z' 8)$(randchars 'A-Z' 8)"
strong_pass="$(randchars 'a-z' 4)$(randchars 'A-Z' 4)$(randchars '0-9' 4)$(randchars '!@#%^+=' 4)"
run_case() {
  label=$1
  value=$2
  out=$(printf '%s\n' "$value" | pwscore 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf '%s rc=%s result=%s\n' "$label" "$rc" "$out"
}
run_case short_11_chars_4_classes "$short_pass"
run_case long_16_chars_2_classes "$two_class_pass"
run_case compliant_16_chars_4_classes "$strong_pass"
unset short_pass two_class_pass strong_pass
